dialogues.speaker: Shatalov
dialogues.text: I-I'm tellin' ya... if... if it weren't for me... grabbin' that net ropes... right at the crucial second...

dialogues.speaker: Shatalov
dialogues.text: That giant octopus... would've... would've flipped The Sea Tsar clean over!

dialogues.speaker: Gorchakov
dialogues.text: Incred... incredible, man! *hic*... I knew I should've gone out to sea with you guys.

dialogues.speaker: Gorchakov
dialogues.text: If it weren't... if it weren't for all that fish I had to dry... and my old lady nagging me up a storm... I-I would've been right there with ya.

dialogues.speaker: Shatalov
dialogues.text: Ah, don't sweat it! There's always next time...

dialogues.speaker: Gorchakov
dialogues.text: Sure is! Next time, I'm gonna ask... Vyazemskaya... Never mind that! Down the hatch! Bottoms up!
